review: 715.3a-1: the does_not_fire variant was the one-Mountain Stomp, which tests mana rather than the rule; the contrast 715.3a decides is the normal creature cast, so normal_cast is now does_not_fire and stomp_one_mana is other.

skipped.reason: covered by 715.3c-1: the copy of Stomp has the Adventure's characteristics only because they are part of the copiable values; copies of permanents show nothing separate

scenarios.title: Casting an adventurer card as an Adventure is judged on the Adventure's characteristics only

setup.notes: It is B's upkeep and A holds priority. Bonecrusher Giant is a {2}{R} creature; its Adventure Stomp is a {1}{R} instant.

decisions: A attempts to cast Bonecrusher Giant as an Adventure (Stomp) targeting B, tapping both Mountains.

variants.label: stomp_two_mana
variants.expected: Legal: only Stomp's {1}{R} cost and instant timing are evaluated, so A can cast it during B's upkeep with two Mountains, even though the creature half could neither be paid for nor cast at that time.

variants.label: stomp_one_mana
variants.delta: A has only one Mountain on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Not legal: Stomp's {1}{R} cost cannot be paid with one land.

variants.label: normal_cast
variants.delta: A attempts to cast Bonecrusher Giant as a creature instead of as an Adventure.
variants.expected: Not legal: the creature half costs {2}{R} and has sorcery timing, and A has two Mountains and it is B's upkeep.

scenarios.title: On the stack an Adventure has only Adventure characteristics; otherwise the card is a creature

setup.notes: Essence Scatter counters target creature spell.

decisions: A casts Bonecrusher Giant as an Adventure (Stomp) targeting B, tapping two Mountains.
With Stomp on the stack, B attempts to cast Essence Scatter targeting Stomp.

variants.label: cast_as_adventure
variants.expected: B cannot cast Essence Scatter: Stomp on the stack is an instant Adventure spell, not a creature spell, so it is not a legal target. Stomp resolves and deals 2 damage to B.

variants.label: cast_as_creature
variants.delta: A casts Bonecrusher Giant as a creature (tapping three Mountains) instead of as an Adventure.
variants.expected: The spell on the stack has the card's normal characteristics and is a creature spell. Essence Scatter can legally target it and counters it; Bonecrusher Giant goes to A's graveyard.

scenarios.title: A copy of an Adventure spell is an Adventure with the Adventure's characteristics

setup.notes: Twincast copies target instant or sorcery spell and lets its controller choose new targets for the copy.

decisions: A casts Bonecrusher Giant as an Adventure (Stomp) targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping two Mountains.
A holds priority and casts Twincast (tapping two Islands) targeting Stomp; both players pass and Twincast resolves, creating a copy of Stomp. A chooses B as the target of the copy.
Both players pass until the copy and then the original Stomp have resolved.

variants.label: copy_resolves_as_stomp
variants.expected: The copy resolves as Stomp and deals 2 damage to B (B at 18). It is not a Bonecrusher Giant creature spell and no creature enters the battlefield. The original Stomp then deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, which dies, and the Bonecrusher Giant card is exiled. The copy ceases to exist.

variants.label: no_copy
variants.expected: Only the original Stomp resolves: Grizzly Bears dies, B stays at 20 life, and the Bonecrusher Giant card is exiled.

variants.label: copy_of_creature_spell
variants.delta: A casts Bonecrusher Giant as a creature (tapping three Mountains) and then tries to cast Twincast on it.
variants.expected: Twincast cannot be cast: a creature spell is not an instant or sorcery spell, so there is no legal target.

scenarios.forge_notes: The copy's use of Stomp's alternative characteristics is also what 715.2b makes copiable.

scenarios.title: A resolved Adventure is exiled and its creature half can be cast from exile, but not the Adventure again

setup.notes: B holds Cancel with three untapped Islands but passes in the base variant.

decisions: A casts Bonecrusher Giant as an Adventure (Stomp) targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping two Mountains.
A, with an empty stack, attempts to cast Stomp again from exile, then casts Bonecrusher Giant as a creature from exile tapping three Mountains; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Stomp deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, which dies, and the card is exiled instead of going to the graveyard. Casting Stomp again from exile is not legal. Casting Bonecrusher Giant as a creature from exile is legal and it enters the battlefield as a 4/3.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: In response to Stomp, B casts Cancel (tapping three Islands) targeting it.
variants.expected: Stomp is countered and the Bonecrusher Giant card goes to A's graveyard, not exile. Grizzly Bears survives. A cannot cast the card from exile because it is not there.

scenarios.title: An adventurer card is one card when discarded

setup.notes: Mind Rot: target player discards two cards.

decisions: A casts Mind Rot targeting B, tapping three Swamps.
Both players pass; Mind Rot resolves and B discards.

variants.label: giant_alone
variants.expected: B's hand holds one card, so B discards that one card: Bonecrusher Giant moves to B's graveyard, which holds exactly one card, and B's hand is empty. It does not count as two cards.

variants.label: giant_and_island
variants.delta: B's hand holds Bonecrusher Giant and Island.
variants.expected: B discards both cards: the graveyard holds exactly Bonecrusher Giant and Island, two cards in total, which is all Mind Rot asks for.

scenarios.title: In the graveyard an adventurer card has only its normal characteristics

setup.notes: Reanimate: put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control; you lose life equal to its mana value.

decisions: A casts Reanimate targeting the card in A's graveyard, tapping Swamp.

variants.label: giant_in_graveyard
variants.expected: Bonecrusher Giant in the graveyard is a creature card with mana value 3, so it is a legal target: it enters the battlefield as a 4/3 under A's control and A loses 3 life (A at 17).

variants.label: instant_in_graveyard
variants.delta: The card in A's graveyard is Shock instead of Bonecrusher Giant.
variants.expected: Shock is not a creature card, so Reanimate has no legal target and cannot be cast; nothing changes.
